subject: Re: ShopLynx renewal — commit elevation & rate corridor confirmation
messages:
From: Amina Qureshi <amina@shoplynx.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@shoplynx.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window — Q3 surge prep and commit proposal

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for last week's call — our engineering and product teams did a deeper review of usage patterns and we want to move faster than originally planned. TL;DR: we'd like to increase our monthly hosted API commit starting Q3 and lock in a slightly higher burst allowance for seasonal spikes.

High level ask:
- Increase monthly token commit from 750M -> 1.2B tokens (starting 2026-07-15).
- Temporary burst window: +60% for up to 10 days within any 30-day period during the quarter.
- Keep current enterprise rate bands but request a 6% discount on the incremental tier for the first 6 months.

I'll attach the internal usage snapshot. We can share a short forecast from our SREs if helpful. Our timeline is tight: procurement aims to sign by 7/8 so we can onboard the extra capacity before the July campaign.

Can you confirm operational impact (rate limits, throttling behavior, cache warming) and an updated commercial? Carlos (cc) will coordinate procurement paperwork.

Appreciate the help — Amina
--
Amina Qureshi
VP, Engineering | ShopLynx
amina@shoplynx.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amina Qureshi <amina@shoplynx.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@shoplynx.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window — Q3 surge prep and commit proposal

Amina — thanks, clear ask and great to see the forecast. We can support the uplift and the burst pattern you described. Quick bullets on what we'll map out for the docs and SOW: 

- Commitment change: move to a 1.2B monthly committed token volume, effective 2026-07-15.
- Burst allowance: we can provision +60% burst for up to 10 days/rolling-30d window as an add-on; will include rules for auto-fallback to secondary model variants if sustained over threshold.
- Rate bands: incremental tier pricing rather than moving your base band; will provide a transitional 6% credit on incremental usage for first 6 months (per your request) pending final approval from finance.
- Ops: no change to per-connection rate limit defaults, but we will increase per-account concurrent streams cap for your org from 20 -> 40 during burst windows and pre-warm KV caches for frequently used prefixes.

I'll pull together a short redlined amendment to the Master Agreement and a pricing worksheet. Karthik, can you draft the commercial with the credit applied and include a DocuSign-ready amendment?

Soojin, can you confirm expected provisioning lead time on dedicated burst capacity and whether any network egress constraints apply in the us-west region?

Amina/Carlos — if you can confirm procurement timeline (7/8 target) we'll prioritize the paperwork. Sending the usage snapshot back in the thread.

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: usage_snapshot_Jan-Jun2026.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>, Amina Qureshi <amina@shoplynx.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@shoplynx.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 10:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window — Q3 surge prep and commit proposal

Sofia / Amina — putting commercial terms here so procurement has a single reference. Draft numbers below (rounding and final DocuSign will follow):

- New monthly commit: 1.2B tokens (billed monthly).
- Base price: $0.0008 per token for the first 750M (unchanged).
- Incremental band (750M -> 1.2B): $0.00065 per token.
- Promotional credit: 6% credit applied to incremental band invoices for first 6 months (applied as line-item credit).
- Burst add-on: $0.10 per additional 1M tokens consumed during burst window beyond 1.2B; burst cap billing aggregated daily.
- Contract term: 12 months from 2026-07-15 with standard SLA and support.

Ops notes: burst windows will be provisioned against our shared capacity pool in us-west; expected provisioning lead-time for guaranteed burst slots is 4 business days after signed amendment. We'll include a clause for automatic fallback to compatible model variants if platform capacity is saturated.

I'll attach a proposed rate table and a redline of the MA. If that looks OK, Sofia — please send DocuSign link and I can shepherd finance sign-off.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: proposed_rate_table_Q3-2026.xlsx
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amina Qureshi <amina@shoplynx.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@shoplynx.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window — Q3 surge prep and commit proposal

Team / Amina — operational confirmation from capacity planning: 

- We can guarantee the +60% burst for up to 10 days in a rolling 30d window, subject to the signed amendment. We reserve the right to throttle sustained traffic beyond burst thresholds; fallback policy will be: 1) throttle to soft-limit, 2) route to compatible model variants, 3) notify SREs.
- Provisioning timeline: 4 business days after DocuSign completed to ensure KV cache pre-warm and increased concurrent stream caps in your org.
- Network: no additional egress constraints in us-west for ShopLynx's regions; if you route through a private VPC peering we'll need to confirm egress billing with infra (let us know if you want a VPC onboarding).
- Recommended pre-warm: run a controlled warm-up job 48 hours prior to first expected burst day to seed caches.

I'll schedule a short ops call with your SREs for tomorrow afternoon to walk the runbook if that helps.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Lead Capacity Planner | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwoodinference.com

Amina/Carlos — thanks everyone, agreed next steps below: 

1) Sofia to upload redlined amendment and pricing worksheet to Drive and share DocuSign by EOD 7/1 (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bShopLynx-Renewal).
2) ShopLynx procurement target: sign by 7/8. Please confirm if legal needs any additional counters.
3) Karthik to finalize rate sheet and attach proposed invoice examples for first 2 months (with 6% credit applied).
4) Soojin to book ops call for tomorrow to review pre-warm checklist; runbook will be attached to the Drive folder.

If we get signature by 7/8, we will enable the elevated commit and provision burst slots for 7/15. I will update the HubSpot deal (DL-2026-0897) and mark the next milestone as "Signed — Provisioning".

One small ask from procurement: please include a single-line summary of the credit treatment for accounting (Karthik, can you add that to the amendment?).

I'll follow up with the DocuSign link in a separate message shortly.

Thanks — Sofia
